name: rent-model
status: DEMO-ONLY: trained on synthetic data (the dataset describes itself as generated from a hedonic pricing model). Must never be shown as a Berlin market estimate.

data.license: Apache 2.0 (Kaggle dataset page, author Sergey Nefedov, last modified 2026-05-23)
data.provenance: RESOLVED: SYNTHETIC. The dataset description states that Ortsteil coordinates, stations and the ECB rate timeline are real anchors (ImmobilienScout24-anchored base prices), but 'listing-level apartment characteristics are generated from the hedonic model'. These are not observed listings.

split_protocol: chronological: train 2020-01..2024-12 (23,779) / val 2025 (4,711) / test 2026-01..04-29 (1,510); old seed-42 random holdout treated as contaminated
leakage_excluded: nebenkosten_eur_monthly (function of area, not a contract field)
transit_distance_min (semantics differ from contract; dropping it costs ~5 EUR MAE)

interval.method: split conformal on log scale, in-time 5-fold OOF residuals of the last 12 months

caveat_test: Test numbers belong to models fit on 2020-2024 only (stage A). The shipped artifact is refit on all rows to 2026-04-29, so it has no untouched holdout.
limitations: Training data is synthetic by the author's own description; a log-linear fit is expected because the generator is a hedonic model. Metrics measure recovery of that generator, not real-market accuracy.
Linear model carries a time trend; stage-A test bias +77 EUR because the 2026 level flattened. Serving fixes t at the last data month and requires periodic retraining.
Only 80 of 97 ALKIS Ortsteile are covered unambiguously (15 absent; Hohenschoenhausen and Treptow ambiguous).
rooms are integers 1-5 in the data; property_type is a room-count label and is not used.
Unknown inputs are marginalised assuming independence between the unknown fields.
